subject.statement: Linda Yaccarino is still the CEO of X.

summary: Bottom line first: Linda Yaccarino is NOT the CEO of X as of 2026-10-01. She was appointed CEO on 2023-06-06, resigned in July 2025, and since then has been CEO of eMed. The weight of reliable sources confirming her resignation and current role outweighs any contrary or ambiguous claims, yielding a FALSE verdict with 99% confidence.

findings.statement: Linda Yaccarino was appointed CEO of X Corp on June 6, 2023.
Linda Yaccarino resigned as CEO of X in July 2025.
As of October 2026, Linda Yaccarino is the CEO of eMed, not X.

conflicts: As of 2026-10-01, what is Linda Yaccarino's official title at X according to the company's leadership page or a reliable source? - supported by adweek.com, cbsnews.com, fortune.com, wsj.com, x.com (weight 2.85) vs refuted by bwmarketingworld.com, finance.yahoo.com, hindustantimes.com, linkedin.com, timesofindia.indiatimes.com (weight 1.70)
conflict_notes: The sources that state Linda Yaccarino is stepping down or no longer CEO of X (adweek.com, cbsnews.com, fortune.com, wsj.com, x.com) carry a combined weight of 2.85, while the sources that describe her as a former CEO or reference her resignation (bwmarketingworld.com, finance.yahoo.com, hindustantimes.com, linkedin.com, timesofindia.indiatimes.com) carry a combined weight of 1.70. The higher weight of the stepping‑down sources, combined with explicit statements of her July 2025 resignation and her current role as CEO of eMed, leads to the conclusion that the claim "Linda Yaccarino is still the CEO of X" is FALSE.
